mapper.select: select id as knowContentId,knowledgetext as content from common_course_knowledge_content where knowledgetext like #{content}
select curriculum,author,synopsis,picture,integral,(select count(*) from common_course_chapter where pid =#{courseid}) AS chaptnumber from common_course where id =#{courseid} and deleted =0

select * from (select a.curriculum,b.chaptername,a.id as courseid ,b.knowledgeid as chapterknowledgeid,a.picture from common_course a left join common_course_chapter b on a.id=b.pid where a.deleted=0 and b.deleted=0 and find_in_set(1,b.knowledgeid)) h left join (select * from (select c.*,d.knowledgecontent from ( select a.knowledgetext,a.knowledgeid,b.editionname from common_course_knowledge_content a left join common_course_knowledge_edition b on a.editionid=b.id where a.id like #{id} and a.deleted=0) c left join common_course_knowledge d on c.knowledgeid=d.id where d.deleted=0) e) j on find_in_set(j.knowledgeid,h.chapterknowledgeid)
select ifnull( (select id from sys_user_integral_record where studenterId =#{studenterId} and keyword='PURCHASECOURSE' and courseid=#{courseid} and status =1 limit 1 ), 0)
select curriculum as conText,id from common_course where deleted=0 and curriculum like #{keyWord}
select knowledgeName as conText,id,courseId from common_course_knowledge_content where deleted=0 and knowledgetext like #{keyWord}
select title as conText,id,questiontype from common_search_question where title like #{keyWord}

SELECT id as courseId,curriculum as courseName,synopsis,author,biography,picture,label, (select COUNT(1) from common_course_purchase where status =1 and studenterid=#{studenterId} AND courseid=#{id}) as isPay FROM common_course where deleted =0 and id=#{id}

select (select count(*) FROM common_collect_course where courseid =#{courseId} and deleted = 0) as collectnumber, (select count(*) from common_student_browsing_history where courseid =#{courseId} ) as browsingnumber, (SELECT count(*) FROM common_course_discuss WHERE courseid = #{courseId} and deleted = 0) as discussnumber , (SELECT count(*) FROM common_course_purchase where studenterid =#{studenterId} and status=1 and courseid= #{courseId} ) as ispay ,a.id,a.curriculum,b.knowledgetext,b.knowledgeName,b.knowledgetextUrl from common_course a left join common_course_knowledge_content b on a.id=b.courseId where a.id=#{courseId} and b.id=#{id}
SELECT choicea as optionA,choiceb as optionB,choicec as optionC,choiced as optionD,title as question,resolving,rightaws as correctOption from common_course_choice where id=#{id}
select choicea as optionA,choiceb as optionB,choicec as optionC,choiced as optionD,title as question,resolving,rightaws as correctOption from common_course_multi where id=#{id}
select title as question,resolving,rightaws as correctOption from common_course_judge where id=#{id}
